metadata.title: A positive-volume ugly band in a smooth Hamiltonian system
metadata.description:
We give an explicit affirmative answer to item 10 of Oliver Knill's 2000 Hamiltonian problem list in the unrestricted smooth symplectic category, with almost periodicity defined by precompact L2 Koopman orbits. A compact connected symplectic four-manifold carries a globally real-valued smooth autonomous Hamiltonian and an invariant open band of normalized full Liouville volume 1/4. All Lyapunov exponents at every band point vanish, yet no invariant measurable subset of positive volume is almost periodic. Each band energy component is already ergodic and non-almost-periodic.

The construction uses classical irrational skew-shift and symplectic mapping-torus mechanisms. Historical first priority is not asserted. The separate weak-mixing guess, prescribed Euclidean or cotangent realizations, analyticity, natural mechanics, contact type, genericity, and robustness are not claimed.

AI tools were used extensively in developing, verifying, and preparing this result, including independent adversarial AI reviews. This is an unrefereed research note; no human peer review or formal proof certification is claimed.

The deposit includes the research note, LaTeX source, frozen original proof and verification scripts, original and fresh independent mathematical checks, and an authored priority/source ledger. Finite exact computations supplement the written proof and do not certify its infinite-dimensional arguments. All verification scripts use Python 3 and its standard library.
